_README: Session 18 (post-election transition). Editorial reference dataset, NOT a
pipeline output. It records the public prediction-market price for the
2026-06-21 Colombia runoff so the website can show the model number next to
the market number as a divergence. Every figure carries its source and the
date it was captured; nothing here is fabricated or guessed.
Why this is a hand-recorded file and not a Pulso market reading: the Pulso
market input (pulso/input_market.py) queries the Polymarket Gamma API with a
narrow term set and recorded the market as unavailable ('no Colombia 2026
runoff market on Polymarket'). A live, public Polymarket market on this race
does in fact exist ('Colombia Presidential Election'); the automated search
simply did not match it. Rather than loosen the automated matcher days after
the freeze, the market price is recorded here by hand WITH its source, and
the model never consumes it. See data_sufficiency and the note below.
Implied probabilities on a prediction market do not sum to 100 (a residual
sits in other/void outcomes); the values are reported as-is, approximate.

market.captured_note: Precio consolidado de la recta final de campana; recogido a mano de la fuente publica, no ingerido por el modelo. En junio el precio de De la Espriella se movio en una banda aproximada de 79 a 85 por ciento.

trajectory.note: Recta final, antes de la votacion.

market.note: Polymarket es un mercado especulativo: el precio refleja el dinero que se mueve sobre el resultado, no una encuesta ni el numero del modelo, y no alimenta el modelo. Es una probabilidad implicita aproximada, no una cifra del modelo ni una recomendacion.
